ThreeJam

A 2D game engine on Three.js where your coding agent proves what its game does.

GitHub npm Changelog

Start

Install ThreeJam in your project:

npm install -D threejam

Give your coding agent the skill that teaches it to build and test games with ThreeJam:

npx skills add https://github.com/aksheyd/threejam/tree/v0.0.4/skills/threejam

Or register ThreeJam's MCP server with your coding agents:

npx threejam mcp add

Example games

Each one is a single HTML file from threejam export. They need a keyboard: on a phone or tablet without one, only Asteroids plays. Tap to start, then hold a finger where you want to shoot.

  • Pong

    Two players at one keyboard, first to 7 points.

    W and S move the left paddle, Up and Down the right; Space starts. Code

  • Breakout

    Clear every brick with three lives.

    Left and Right, or A and D, move the paddle; Space serves. Code

  • Snake

    Eat apples to grow, and don't hit a wall or yourself.

    An arrow key starts the snake, and the arrow keys turn it; Space plays again. Code

  • Flappy

    Flap through the gaps between the pipes.

    Space starts a run, and each press flaps. Code

  • Invaders

    Clear the wave before the invaders reach the bottom.

    Left and Right move the cannon; Space starts and fires, and holding it keeps firing. Code

  • Tetris

    Fill rows to clear them, until a new piece has no room.

    Left and Right move the piece, Up rotates it, and Down drops it faster; Space starts. Code

  • Asteroids

    Shoot the rocks, which split when hit, and don't let them hit you.

    Left and Right turn, Up thrusts, and Space fires; or hold the mouse to aim and fire, and the right button to thrust. Space or a click starts. Code

ThreeJam is a prototype, and some things aren't in it yet. MIT license. Releases
